g.text: D120 + 47k: cold pull-up of both drains (FMEA H-1) for plug-out FET-short detection. In flight: log only, never veto (F-10).

g.desc: D120 + 47k: cold pull-up of both drains (FMEA H-1) for plug-out FET-short detection. In flight: log only, never veto (F-10).

g.text: CONT = 10k/1k from drain (open detector only, CIRCUIT_REVIEW 2.9). ARMn_SENSE = 10k/1k from each fused bus.

g.desc: CONT = 10k/1k from drain (open detector only, CIRCUIT_REVIEW 2.9). ARMn_SENSE = 10k/1k from each fused bus.

g.text: PE3 (pin 2) and PE6 (pin 5) are sentinels with no net: firmware drives them low. Never enable TRACE on PE2-PE6.

g.desc: PE3 (pin 2) and PE6 (pin 5) are sentinels with no net: firmware drives them low. Never enable TRACE on PE2-PE6.

g.text: Gate: MCU -> 220R -> gate; 1k pull-down on MCU side; 10k + 220nF gate-source (P0-1/P0-2). Off in reset/unpowered.

g.desc: Gate: MCU -> 220R -> gate; 1k pull-down on MCU side; 10k + 220nF gate-source (P0-1/P0-2). Off in reset/unpowered.

g.text: With the plug out NOTHING connects RAW_ACT to PYRO1_BUS or PYRO2_BUS (AGENTS.md safety rule 1). No test point on BUS/OUT.

g.desc: With the plug out NOTHING connects RAW_ACT to PYRO1_BUS or PYRO2_BUS (AGENTS.md safety rule 1). No test point on BUS/OUT.

g.text: Igniter 1 across J121.1-2, igniter 2 across J121.3-4. Both terminal pin orders are reversal-symmetric.

g.desc: Igniter 1 across J121.1-2, igniter 2 across J121.3-4. Both terminal pin orders are reversal-symmetric.

g.text: Two independent channels (FMEA H-5). ARM plug = 4-wire, 2-fuse link: J120.4->F1 5A FAST->J120.3 (BUS1), J120.1->F2 5A FAST->J120.2 (BUS2).

g.desc: Two independent channels (FMEA H-5). ARM plug = 4-wire, 2-fuse link: J120.4->F1 5A FAST->J120.3 (BUS1), J120.1->F2 5A FAST->J120.2 (BUS2).
